distinguishing_features: Onkyo NR-series 2022 generation, 7.2-ch, NO THX (THX is the NR6100/NR7100), 4 HDMI in / 2 out, Zone B (not powered Zone 2), no phono input, no front USB (USB is rear only), front panel printed 'AV RECEIVER TX-NR5100', input row BD/DVD-GAME-CBL/SAT-STRM BOX-PC-AUX-CD-TV-TUNER-NET-BLUETOOTH (no PHONO key), button above first input key reads 'ZONE A/B'. Not to be confused with predecessor TX-NR696 / TX-NR5100's sibling TX-NR6100. 230V (European/Asian) variant applies in Israel; black only.

conflicts.supplier_claim: 165 וואט לערוץ (supplier price list, row TX-NR5100)
conflicts.manufacturer: 165 W is the North American rating at 10% THD: "165 W at 6 ohms, 1 kHz, 1 ch driven of 10% THD" (manual, North American models; also onkyo.com refurb page "165 W/Ch (6 ohms, 1 kHz, 10% THD, 1-ch driven)"). European/Asian 230V models are rated 7 ch × 135 W at 6 ohms, 1 kHz, 1% THD (IEC) (manual + EMEA spec sheet). The EMEA sheet's marketing paragraph also says "150W/Ch" without conditions. US FTC rating: 80 W/Ch (8 ohms, 20 Hz–20 kHz, 0.08% THD, 2-ch driven).
conflicts.resolution: spec_facts uses the 230V IEC rating with full conditions; do NOT write a bare '165W' in copy.
left out of spec_facts (manufacturer sources disagree)
